sentences.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
sentences.zh: 与城市生活相比，乡村生活非常宁静。

sentences.en: My car looks shabby in comparison with his new one.
sentences.zh: 我的车和他那辆新车比起来显得破旧。

sentences.en: Catalonia is a small nation in comparison with some others.
sentences.zh: 加泰罗尼亚相对于其他一些国家来说是一个小国。

senses.zh: 比较, 对照 - 经比较得出的结论 - 类似, 相似

mnemonic: 词根记忆：com+par（平等）+ison→比较相等→比较
